**P2 — Monitor all launched markers during cleanup**

`events_for` reads only the cached CloudWatch events, and `stop_all` polls the durable API without refreshing logs. If an asynchronous invocation or already-dispatched retry enters after the last case poll, its marker is omitted here, cleanup reports success, and the next case can start while that wrapper still occupies capacity. Pass every marker launched by the case to a quiescence check that refreshes logs, permits no-entry cases only after a quiet period, and requires every observed entry to return; add a delayed-entry regression test.
